hints.title: Direct Step Simulation
hints.text: For small array bounds, simulate each operation step by finding whether consecutive items are ordered.

hints.title: Minimal Adjacent Pair Scan
hints.text: Scan every adjacent pair from left to right, identify the pair with the smallest sum, and break ties by choosing the leftmost pair.

hints.title: In-place Array Replacement
hints.text: Replace the pair with their combined sum and repeat until every element is less than or equal to its successor.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct scanning per merge operation operates comfortably within small constraints.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force search of all merge orders is unnecessary because each step is deterministic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mutating an array copy simulates adjacent merges in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement deterministic greedy replacement with correct tie-breaking.
